data.one_liner: Detects biometric data changes like added fingerprints or Face ID to prevent unauthorized access.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that monitors biometric enrollment changes on Android and iOS devices. It uses native event streams and lifecycle observers to alert your app if a user has added or removed a face or fingerprint since the last check.
use_when: You want to protect high-security apps from unauthorized biometric enrollment.
You need real-time streams or one-shot checks for biometric modifications.
avoid_when: You only need standard biometric authentication without tracking subsequent hardware configuration changes.
strengths: Native monitoring via Kotlin Coroutines and Swift without Dart-side lifecycle hacks.
Persistent status tracking until explicitly acknowledged.
Cross-platform support for both iOS and Android.
weaknesses: Android face recognition detection depends on manufacturer Class 3 Strong biometric implementation.
data.setup_notes: Requires minimum SDK API 23 for Android and iOS 12.0 deployment target.

alternatives.name: local_auth
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose local_auth if you only need standard biometric authentication prompts rather than tracking underlying biometric data changes.
